messages:
maria (Sales): Heads up — got a SIG/CAIQ from NimbusEdge. They insisted on BYOK (HSM preferred) and want SLA carveouts for PII handling. I put the questionnaire in the intake folder: https://drive.redwood/nimbus/sig.pdf
logan (AE): Thanks. Can Security pick this up? We have a demo in 2 weeks, need clear yes/no on BYOK for the POC and a pricing delta if extra infra is needed.
sophie (Security): I'll own intake. Quick clarifying q: do they need HSM-backed keys for both at-rest and customer-managed encryption for model state or only data blobs? Also we'll need a CAIQ evidence bundle.
maria (Sales): They specified BYOK for stored data + model context snapshots. HSM if possible, otherwise strong KMS. Timeline is tight.
kevin (Solutions Eng): If we need HSM-backed BYOK we must prepare a private deployment variant and validate key wrapping — estimate +2 days setup and some infra changes. Rough pricing impact: +$600/day for dedicated infra during POC.
logan (AE): Noted. We need a firm cost delta to share. Can you confirm infra ETA and whether features are compatible with our hosted offering?
sophie (Security): Hosted won't support HSM BYOK for tenant keys today. Options: 1) Private deployment with customer KMS/HSM integration (recommended) 2) Customer uses their own KMS and we accept wrapped keys for session-level data (less ideal). I'll compile a risk note.
maria (Sales): Customer asked also for evidence staging location and access controls. Where should we put artefacts?
sophie (Security): Upload evidence to secure-staging bucket: s3://rwd-security-evidence/nimbusedge/poc. Grant read to the security group and kevin, maria. Do not share public links.
sec-bot: Ticket INF-4921 created and assigned to sophie. ETA: 48h for initial intake review.
maria (Sales): Uploaded draft answers to doc: https://docs.redwood/inbound/nimbus-sig-draft — please annotate.
sophie (Security): Reviewed and added CAIQ references. Missing: architecture diagram showing key separation and KMS flow. @kevin can you drop that diagram?
kevin (Solutions Eng): Uploaded a quick sketch: https://draw.redwood/123-key-arch — will produce final diagram tonight.
logan (AE): Sales needs final position on BYOK (yes/no) and the price delta by EOD tomorrow. Any blockers?
sophie (Security): Blockers: legal needs to review KMS terms for customer-managed keys (BYOK TOU) and engineering needs to validate HSM compatibility with our runtime. I've looped Legal and added them to the evidence bucket.
maria (Sales): Marking as P1 for the deal and flagging demo dependency. :eyes:
logan (AE): If we can't enable HSM for POC, can we propose a mitigated flow (customer manages keys + private deployment) and a temporary controls checklist for demo?
sophie (Security): Yes — fallback is private deployment with customer KMS. That reduces risk. I'll draft the mitigation and include a redlined SLA excerpt for the legal team to review.
kevin (Solutions Eng): If we go fallback route, infra work is ~4-6 hours. Updated cost calc here: https://internal.redwood/pricing/nimbus-poc-calc (summary +$600/day for dedicated infra, one-time setup fee $1,200).
sophie (Security): Will update thread once Legal signs off on TOU and we've validated HSM compatibility. Also attached a short checklist in the bucket: s3://rwd-security-evidence/nimbusedge/checklist.md
maria (Sales): Great — I'll tell the customer we're tracking this as high priority and expect an update tomorrow. Thanks all :rocket:
